title: cyclophyllum marquesense
intro: Cyclophyllum marquesense, commonly known as the Marquesas Island tree, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Pacific Island medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Cyclophyllum marquesense include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
